text: The reference workflow harness runs in SIT in namespace rwb-recovery against the published contracts and the workflow interface, starts ReferenceCaseWorkflow on the task queue rwb-case with the workflow ID prefix ref-case- and the synthetic flag true, publishes and replays the case events EV-CASE-0777-01 to EV-CASE-0777-05 on rwb.case.events.v1 with CloudEvents headers and the event key, replaces each fake as its I story lands, and its evidence is a per-run report keyed by story and business date.
why: No source read gives the harness repository, its SIT environment, the seeding set and script, the evidence format and retention, the pass or fail gate or the exact fake answers, and the ownership map holds no rwb-case outbox delivery read; the run cannot wait for a decision on them, so the harness is defined as contract-first, test-only and deterministic per business date, and the missing read is carried as a gap.
read: Template and Rules v1 R5.4, R5.5 (DP-01, DP-03, DP-04, DP-05, DP-07, DP-09, DP-10, DP-11, DP-14, DP-15, DP-19), R7.2 and R9; Architecture v5 Text Extract v1 slides 11, 13, 14, 18, 20, 41, 42 and 44; Temporal and Drools Design Text Extract v1 slides 11 to 16 and 27 to 28; _work/msr/plan/ownership.json (events, workflows and operations); legacy RWB-E2-043 sections 3, 12 and 13
confirm: Integration lead and QA lead at the wave 2 entry check, with the rwb-case owner for the outbox delivery read
impact: The harness runs on the section 12.8 fakes and the case-event stub from Day 1 and proves the four-step order, the failure isolation, the idempotent retry and the pinned version before the two I stories land; only the real-service cut-over, the seeding set, the evidence sign-off and any added outbox delivery read wait for the confirmation.
